qa_pair.question: In the quick-check split, the subset of mixed Grantha and Tamil writing contains items drawn on two kinds of support. How many of its items are on palm leaves?
Of the Tesseract configurations with results on the ranked split, which one reads the real Tirukkural manuscript leaves best? Give its run id.

Take the system ranked last by its average over the reading tracks. On what percentage of its reading answers does it produce letters from a script that the references never use? Answer to one decimal place without the % sign.
Among the subsets in the inscriptions track, one expects its answers romanised rather than written in Tamil letters. What is that subset's id?
The benchmark has a task that asks what the writing is physically on (stone, leaf, screen and so on). How many answers is a model allowed to choose from?
In the quick-check split of the oldest Tamil script's subset, consider the items built from invented words rather than real text. What is the image width in pixels of the one with the smallest id?

On the real palm leaves, is the difference between Tesseract with the tessdata_best Tamil model and Tesseract with Ubuntu's Tamil model statistically separable at 95 % on paired resampling? Answer yes or no.
On the synthetic palm leaves, which Tamil letter substitution does the Tesseract configuration based on the whole-script Tamil model make most often? Answer in the form X→Y.
The benchmark data carries a marker meant to keep it out of training corpora. What is the GUID in that marker?
In the ranked split's script-identification subset, how many items have the ancient Brahmi-derived Tamil script as the correct answer?
